_doc: Forward-only floor for `_t(en, fil)` calls whose two arms are identical - a translation that can never happen. A NEW one fails the gate `bilingual-t-arms`; the floor only ever drops. Some entries are legitimate (a product name, a loan word the plant floor says in English).
reason: asset-hub.html copy lens (W45877): the risk chip called _t('risk','risk'), so every asset card read 'HIGH RISK 74%' in English on the Filipino page - the one verdict on the register a supervisor scans for. The Filipino arm is 'panganib'.
